name: AILA
title:
Evaluating large language model agents for automation of atomic force microscopy
中文标题：评估大语言模型智能体在原子力显微镜自动化中的应用
mechanism: 固定路由、工具调用和环境反馈
source_location: 正式期刊PDF：Fig. 1–3、AILA工作流、AFMBench、单代理与多代理比较，以及Supplementary Information §S6。注意该直接对照只覆盖所报告的子集和模型。

name: 协作收益边界
title:
Capable language models can outgrow the benefits of collaboration
中文标题：能力更强的语言模型可能不再从协作中获益
mechanism: 比较组织方式；本身不是新的学习更新规则
not_implemented: 没有实现论文的通信结构、模型家族和260配置评估
source_location:
主文架构比较与Methods；PDF后部“Structural ablations”及通信设计说明。注意其跨任务关系分析不等于无限外推。
English: The experimental variable is team organization and information flow, not the agents’ model weights.

name: MAP
title:
A brain-inspired agentic architecture to improve planning with LLMs
中文标题：一种受脑启发、用于改进大语言模型规划的智能体架构
mechanism: 功能模块规划与合法性监测
not_implemented: BFS仅展示模块分工，没有实现LLM状态预测和原任务
source_location:
PDF约第6页，Table 1与Table 2；架构图、Methods及各规划任务说明。
English: The architecture changes inference-time roles, information flow, and search, without showing online weight updates.

name: LegoNE
title:
Discovering expert-level Nash equilibrium algorithms with large language models
中文标题：利用大语言模型发现专家级纳什均衡算法
mechanism: 候选算法生成、编译反馈、理论评价
not_implemented: 用线性程序变异代替LLM；没有纳什均衡模块或理论证明器
source_location: 正式期刊PDF：Fig. 1的LLM—LegoNE反馈循环；Results中的保证值和对照算法；Methods中的多阶段提示、编译错误反馈与专家提供的模块。

name: Coscientist
title:
Autonomous chemical research with large language models
中文标题：利用大语言模型开展自主化学研究
mechanism: 工具执行与实验反馈闭环
not_implemented: 没有实验设备、反应优化和论文提示词
source_location:
主文系统架构、工具能力及反应优化实验；Fig. 6（约PDF第8页）。与第10篇Co-Scientist不是同一系统。
English: The system mainly updates experimental conditions, plans, and recorded context, not the GPT-4 weights.

name: ChemCrow
title:
Augmenting large language models with chemistry tools
中文标题：用化学工具增强大语言模型
not_implemented: 只有算术工具路由；没有化学工具；不是多智能体训练
source_location:
主文ChemCrow流程、工具集、评价部分；Methods中工具说明。
English: Tool access and the current execution trace change, while the LLM weights remain untouched.

name: CASSIA
title:
CASSIA: a multi-agent large language model for automated and interpretable cell annotation
中文标题：CASSIA：用于自动且可解释细胞注释的多智能体大语言模型
mechanism: 注释、验证、质量评分与修订
not_implemented: 已知数字目标代替细胞标注；没有生物数据与LLM验证
source_location:
正式PDF Methods约第11—12页：Annotation、Validation、Quality scoring；主文讨论及Supplementary Note 6入口。期刊卷期年份为2026，DOI含2025不代表出版年。
English: The system revises the current annotations and explanations; it does not fine-tune the base LLM after each task.

name: FunSearch
title:
Mathematical discoveries from program search with large language models
中文标题：利用大语言模型进行程序搜索以发现数学规律
mechanism: 生成、执行评价、保存优良程序、再生成
not_implemented: 没有LLM程序生成、岛屿迁移和原数学任务
source_location:
主文Fig. 1、program database；Methods中island-based approach及评价器。在线发表于2023年12月，正式卷期为2024。
English: The program population and generated code change, while the underlying language model remains frozen.

name: G-Frame / OmniChem
title:
Game theory driven multi-agent framework mitigates language model hallucination
中文标题：基于博弈论的多智能体框架缓解语言模型幻觉
mechanism: 博弈驱动多代理数据生成与下游训练
not_implemented: 仅生成—验证—训练链条；没有team/Bayesian game和Qwen训练
source_location:
正式期刊PDF：§2、Fig. 1–3、Methods中的Team/Bayesian games伪代码及训练阶段分析；引用以本条DOI为准。
English: The framework changes workflow decisions and also updates the downstream model’s parameters.

name: Co-Scientist
title:
Accelerating scientific discovery with Co-Scientist
中文标题：利用Co-Scientist加速科学发现
mechanism: 生成、批评、锦标赛排序与假说进化
not_implemented: 仅候选搜索类比；没有Elo锦标赛、文献检索和实验验证
source_location:
正式期刊PDF（含补充材料）：Fig. 1、tournament/evolution、test-time compute评价与三类应用验证。
English: The system updates candidate hypotheses, review records, rankings, and search direction, not the Gemini weights.

name: X-ray scientist
title:
An agentic artificially intelligent X-ray scientist
中文标题：具有智能体能力的人工智能X射线科学家
not_implemented: 没有真实仪器；不引入新的学习算法
source_location:
主文系统示意、模拟/真实设备实验与Discussion；PDF约第7页关于不引入新学习算法及不微调LLM的说明。
English: The system changes experiment settings, action plans, and task state; the paper reports neither a new learning algorithm nor LLM fine-tuning.

name: LLM-RDF
title:
An automatic end-to-end chemical synthesis development platform powered by large language models
中文标题：由大语言模型驱动的自动端到端化学合成开发平台
mechanism: 多角色编排加外部优化器
not_implemented: 没有反应优化器、人类衔接和端到端化学任务
source_location:
Fig. 1；Results开头“LLM-based agents for end-to-end chemical synthesis reaction development”；Methods及反应优化实验。
English: Prompts and documents define roles; runtime changes mainly affect plans, records, and optimizer state rather than GPT-4 weights.

name: DeepSeek-R1
title:
DeepSeek-R1 incentivizes reasoning in LLMs through reinforcement learning
中文标题：DeepSeek-R1通过强化学习激发大语言模型的推理能力
mechanism: 组内相对奖励的强化学习；完整R1含多训练阶段
not_implemented: 单步4动作策略，仅展示组优势、旧策略比率、裁剪、精确KL；不是token级GRPO
source_location:
主文R1-Zero、R1训练流程及Methods中的GRPO；补充材料入口见论文末尾。
English: The model parameters change directly, providing a clear example of persistent learning in a single model.

name: AMIE诊断
title:
Towards conversational diagnostic artificial intelligence
中文标题：面向对话式诊断的人工智能
mechanism: 多角色模拟交互形成训练数据，再微调；推理时另有修订
update_target: 数据/模型权重/当前回复
not_implemented: 规则算术角色代替自我对话，没有临床病例、LLM训练或临床评测
source_location:
期刊Methods“Simulated learning through self-play”与推理策略；正式期刊PDF：Methods中“Simulated learning through self-play”与推理策略。正式版引用以上DOI。
English: The method iterates training data and changes model weights, while deployment can also revise the current response.

name: AMIE疾病管理
title:
Towards conversational artificial intelligence for disease management
中文标题：面向疾病管理的对话式人工智能
mechanism: 后训练、双代理编排、检索与纵向状态
not_implemented: 拆开演示组件；没有复现完整混合系统；记忆算法是本项目设计
source_location:
Fig. 1–3；Methods：Dialogue agent/Posttraining、Agent state、Mx agent；主文“Ablations of model and agents”、Extended Data Fig. 2；完整消融细节指向Supplementary Information。
English: The system changes model weights, orchestration and retrieval settings, and patient-specific state at different layers.
